blocks.value: Position sizing means deciding how much money to invest in a single stock. Even a good company can become a risky investment if too much money is invested in it.
Imagine This: A balanced meal contains rice, vegetables, dal and fruits. Eating only one food in a very large quantity isn't healthy. Your investment portfolio should also be balanced.
Many experienced investors avoid putting a very large percentage of their portfolio into a single stock.
An investor with ₹5,00,000 may decide not to invest more than ₹50,000 in any one company.
⚠️ Even the best companies can face unexpected problems.
Good investing is about managing position size as much as choosing good companies.

blocks.question: What is position sizing?
choices: Deciding how much money to invest in one investment.
